fusions.name: Owner's Mark
fusions.desc: A branding kick that deals 8 damage, leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds and [Marked] for 8 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Clanging Shoes
fusions.desc: A ringing sweep that deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stuns each for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Cold Plate
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 28 damage and holds for 10 seconds. Your armour rises by 10% while it lasts.

fusions.name: Unbending
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 15%. You also have 10% physical resistance.
